purpose: reference-aware headroom and candidate-recall diagnostic; not a baseline competitor and not an exact upper bound

configurations.search: source-order-delivered forward greedy addition; accept only gains greater than 1e-9; exact source-index tie resolves to the earliest index
configurations.multi_reference_rule: candidate gain maximizes the optimization target over references; reported metrics use the same target-selected reference
configurations.requested_min_rule: do not force-fill the frozen system floor; reference-aware diagnostic stops when no positive target gain remains and reports achieved length

execution.document_parallelism: execution-only; worker count does not enter the scientific configuration hash
execution.schema_or_row_failure: fail the configuration; never skip a row

success.correctness: every target covers the exact frozen-dev ID sequence and records selected indices plus per-row metrics
success.interpretation: report metric-specific headroom separately; never combine targets into a synthetic oracle summary and never call the result an upper bound
success.promotion: none; this diagnostic informs headroom and candidate recall only
